title: Horizontal and vertical combination algorithm for federated learning

pse.problem: Existing federated learning algorithms cannot achieve simultaneous expansion of dimensional features and sample size for global model training and deployment in uncertain data sources and diverse data collection forms.
pse.solution_function: The invention presents a federated learning algorithm that performs horizontal-vertical combination, expanding dimensional features and sample size for global model training and deployment through data synchronization, model initialization, data alignment, and vertical federated learning. It improves the overall accuracy of the model by transferring gradients between vertical and horizontal federations.
pse.solution_structure: The algorithm consists of participating nodes (participants), databases with latitude characteristics, a horizontal global parameter, vertical model parameters, unique weights w for each participant, feature x for each participant, and a gradient transfer ratio.
pse.solution_implementation: The algorithm begins with data synchronization and model initialization, followed by data alignment. Afterward, it trains the vertical federated learning model on aligned data by using each participant's unique weight w and feature x to obtain gradients that are transferred proportionally between vertical and horizontal federations.
pse.effect: The solution results in a more accurate federation model due to simultaneous expansion of dimensional features and sample size for global training and deployment.
